_about: Albert Curtis Clark (1859-1937), Corpus Professor of Latin at Oxford, raw IA OCR of The Cursus in Mediaeval and Vulgar Latin (1910). Latin and the study of the language (lane B, round eb: eighth IA subject sweep). No uids minted. Round ec adds his Pro Milone with English commentary (1895); a Classical Review issue (Fictitious MSS. of Bosius) and the Latin-dense Vetus Cluniacensis were passed over.

albert-c-clark-cursus-1910: The Cursus in Mediaeval and Vulgar Latin, by Albert C. Clark, a paper read to the Oxford Philological Society on February 18, 1910 (Oxford: at the Clarendon Press, 1910)
albert-c-clark-pro-milone-1895: M. Tulli Ciceronis Pro T. Annio Milone ad iudices oratio, with introduction and commentary by Albert C. Clark (Oxford: at the Clarendon Press, 1895)
